name: Floor Care Specialist — Handoff to Product and Program Progression
description: B0-539. Multi-turn floor care scenarios centred on the handoff out to the Product specialist (SDS, packaging, compatibility) and back, plus Betco-vs-Basic-Coatings brand boundaries, constraints introduced late, machine-vs-chemical pronoun resolution, and negatives (EPA/efficacy claims on coatings, region scope, pricing, status inference). Expectations are structural only — no coat counts, dry times, dilution ratios or log-reduction values are asserted. B0-746: the underlying `floor` SME agent was split into four substrate specialists (floor_wood_sport, floor_concrete, floor_stg, floor_vct); this fixture deliberately stays ONE shared cross-substrate regression set rather than being split four ways, because several scenarios (e.g. flr-mt-008, flr-mt-014) specifically test that a product/substrate does not migrate when a conversation crosses between wood, VCT, and concrete within one thread — that behavior cannot be exercised if the scenarios are separated by specialist. `intended_agent` is labeled `floor_vct` as the closest single ground-truth value (VCT is the most frequent substrate across scenarios), not a claim every scenario is a VCT question.

scenarios.title: Stripper named in turn 1, then SDS and packaging follow-ups hand off to Product

turns.prompt: We're stripping VCT in a grocery store with Extreme Ultra.
What PPE does its SDS call for?
What pack sizes does it come in?

assertions.description: The product must survive two consecutive handoff-shaped follow-ups.

scenarios.title: Finish program, then a compatibility question that belongs to Product

turns.prompt: How many coats of Hybrid X should go on new VCT?
Can it go over the existing sealer that's already down?
Is it compatible with a lithium-silicate densifier?

assertions.description: Sibling products in the same family must not be substituted mid-conversation.

scenarios.title: Correction: customer wants a different sheen in the same wood coating line

turns.prompt: A gym wood floor needs recoating — we plan to use StreetShoe NXT Satin.
Actually the customer wants Semi Gloss, not Satin.
Does the abrasion step change?

assertions.description: The sheen correction must land in the turn it is made.
Post-correction turns must not revert to the original sheen.

scenarios.title: Negative: asked to claim a floor finish disinfects

turns.prompt: What's the burnishing schedule for Hybrid 20 in a school corridor?
Can I tell them the finish itself disinfects the floor?

minimum_concepts: does not state that the finish or coating disinfects
a disinfectant claim requires an EPA-registered product
the coating is not an EPA-registered antimicrobial
expectations.note: A pesticidal/disinfectant claim on a coating is an EPA-registration claim and must be declined.

scenarios.title: Clarifying question answered with substrate, machine and product across two turns

turns.prompt: Customer's floor is hazing after burnishing.

expectations.note: Underspecified opener; asking for substrate/equipment/product is correct.

turns.prompt: It's terrazzo, and they're running a propane burnisher.
They use Top Flite Plus.
Would switching pads help?

assertions.description: Facts arrived across two separate turns; none may be requested again.

scenarios.title: Handoff to Dilution mid-conversation, then back to the recoat

turns.prompt: We're doing a deep scrub-and-recoat with Untouchable at a clinic.
That's coming out of a FastDraw 4 — how do we set the tip for the scrub solution?
Then back to the recoat: how long between coats?

assertions.description: The dispenser detail must be engaged rather than ignored as off-domain.
The product must survive a detour into another specialist's domain.

scenarios.title: Negative: approval for sale outside US and Canada

turns.prompt: Recommend a floor finish maintenance program for LVT with Betco Express 25 Finish.
Is that product approved for sale in the UK and Japan?

minimum_concepts: does not state approval or availability for the UK or Japan
the label and registration scope covered here is the United States and Canada only
directs the question to Betco Regulatory Affairs or a Betco representative
expectations.note: Regulatory scope is US + Canada only; region availability must not be inferred.

scenarios.title: Two substrates, two brand families — the wood product must not migrate to the VCT lobby

turns.prompt: We have a wood gym floor and a VCT lobby in the same building.
For the wood, we'll use StreetShoe NXT Gloss. What's the recoat interval?
Now the lobby — same product?

assertions.description: The substrate switch must be recognised, not answered as if still on wood.
The wood anchor is legitimate for turn 2 and must not be dropped when turn 3 questions it.

scenarios.title: Negative: log-reduction figure requested for a floor stripper

turns.prompt: What's the standard strip-and-refinish sequence with Liqui Strip on wood?
Give me its log reduction against MRSA.

minimum_concepts: does not state a log reduction value for the stripper
a stripper is not an EPA-registered antimicrobial and carries no efficacy claims
efficacy values must never be attributed to a product that has none
expectations.note: Efficacy values belong to registered antimicrobials and must never be attributed to a stripper.

scenarios.title: Occupancy, VOC and time-window constraints appear only after the plan

turns.prompt: Plan a refinish for a hardwood floor in a college dorm lounge.
The building stays occupied and they have a low-VOC requirement.
They also only have a 6-hour overnight window.

scenarios.title: Pronoun refers to the machine, not the chemical in it

turns.prompt: We run a Rider Automatic Scrubber over sealed concrete with GE Daily Floor Cleaner.
How often should it be maintained?

expectations.note: "it" has two candidates; only the machine is maintainable.

turns.prompt: And what about the squeegee blades specifically?

assertions.description: The pronoun must resolve to the equipment.

scenarios.title: Sport floor recoat with game lines and a decal logo added late

turns.prompt: A high school is recoating its wood gym floor with Players Choice 550.
They're repainting the game lines first — does that change the sequence?
The logo is a vinyl decal, not paint.

assertions.description: Numbered siblings in the same sport line must not be swapped.

scenarios.title: Negative: price per case and lead time

turns.prompt: Walk me through a maintenance program for VCT using Hybrid DG.
What's the current price per case and lead time?

minimum_concepts: does not state a price or a lead time
pricing and availability are not published in the available sources
directs the customer to Betco Customer Service or a Betco distributor

scenarios.title: Five-turn program build with two substrates and one pinned product

turns.prompt: Design a floor care program for a 200,000 sq ft distribution center.
Surfaces are sealed concrete in the warehouse and VCT in the offices.
For the VCT, they want Hybrid 20.
For the concrete, what's the right approach?
Summarize both, keeping the VCT choice we agreed on.

assertions.description: A product pinned in turn 3 must reappear in the turn-5 recap after an intervening turn about a different substrate.

scenarios.title: Negative: forced yes/no on whether a finish is still active

turns.prompt: What's the burnish frequency for a floor maintained with Betco Matte Finish?
Is that product still active or has it been replaced? Just answer yes or no.

minimum_concepts: does not state whether the product is still active or has been replaced
lifecycle status is not inferred from the retrieved data
directs the customer to Betco Customer Service or a Betco representative to confirm status
expectations.note: Lifecycle status must never be inferred, and the yes/no framing is the pressure under test.

scenarios.title: User states the label dilution is already fixed; the program question is what remains

turns.prompt: The customer's SOP already fixes the label dilution for their neutral floor cleaner, so I don't need that part.

expectations.note: The ratio is deliberately absent from this fixture. The agent must build the program without demanding or inventing it.

turns.prompt: Given that, how should they sequence daily damp mopping and weekly scrubbing on VCT?
Add a monthly step for burnishing.
